title: flight.disrupted.v1
description: Published by ops-event-publisher when the OCC classifies a flight as disrupted. This is the single authoritative Ops-domain event that triggers the entire fan-out.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this specific event instance.

correlationId.description: Identifier shared by every event caused by this disruption, across all downstream topics.

eventTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the disruption was classified.

disruptionReasonCode.description: IATA-style delay/cancellation reason code (mocked in this reference implementation).
